top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Information Exposure Through Debug Log Files
top_sast_rules.description: Sensitive information is written to debug or diagnostic log files.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-534 debug-log diagnostic-log verbose-log sensitive-log password token credential secret exception stacktrace logging
top_sast_rules.remediation: Redact secrets and disable sensitive diagnostic logging.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
top_sast_rules.description: Binding a socket to all interfaces opens it up to traffic from any IPv4 address and is therefore associated with security risks.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Find code that may expose sensitive information in error messages, logs, or responses
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement proper access controls. Use generic error messages for users. Avoid exposing sensitive information in error responses, debugging output, or log files.

top_sast_rules.description: Disabling or weakening CSRF protection may make the application vulnerable to a Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attack.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Find state-changing operations that lack CSRF protection mechanisms
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement CSRF tokens for all state-changing operations. Use SameSite cookie attributes and validate the Origin/Referer headers.

top_sast_rules.description: Ignoring return values may result in discarding errors or loss of information.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere
top_sast_rules.description: A protected resource crosses its intended trust or control boundary and becomes accessible to an unintended actor.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-668 wrong-sphere control-sphere trust-boundary resource-exposure unintended-actor private-resource public-exposure insecure-permission cross-boundary
top_sast_rules.remediation: Keep protected resources inside their intended trust boundary.

top_sast_rules.description: Use of a non-constant-time verification routine to check the value of an secret, possibly allowing a timing attack to retrieve sensitive information.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
